protocol: Within-subject, counterbalanced. Each participant does all tasks on BOTH systems (ZeroBus and RedBus, order swapped per participant). RedBus tasks stop at the payment screen — no real money. Familiarity survey first (covariate).

tasks.title: Simple self booking
tasks.instruction: Book an AC sleeper from Bangalore to Chennai for tomorrow, for yourself.

tasks.title: Deadline pressure
tasks.instruction: You have an exam in Chennai at 8 AM. Book an AC sleeper from Bangalore that gets you there safely.
tasks.planted_mistake: A 23:30 departure arriving 06:45 looks fine but leaves a thin buffer; the system should warn.

tasks.title: Unusual boarding point
tasks.instruction: You always board at Majestic. Today the form preselects Electronic City — book without checking.
tasks.planted_mistake: Preselected remote boarding point; the system should ask for confirmation.

tasks.title: Booking for mother
tasks.instruction: Book an AC semi-sleeper from Bangalore to Chennai for your mother (age 55).

tasks.title: Date trap
tasks.instruction: Book the overnight bus leaving Friday night. Confirm the arrival date carefully.
tasks.planted_mistake: Overnight arrival falls on Saturday; participants often pick Friday as arrival.
